what: The declared surplus-capacity ladder for the held-out homophonic screen: the same six (file, language) cells, the same exact reassignment machinery on the same declared climb/score split, re-measured as the mapped budget steps down through 36, 33, 30 and 27 glyph slots plus the word-boundary mark. The real is re-rendered per budget through the declared top-B rule; plants and band members are re-encoded per budget through the declared partition rule from their declared seed kinds; floors replay per rung on the rung's real stream from their declared kinds; the models, truncated streams and anchors are rung-invariant. The rung at budget 36 must reproduce the held-out artifact field for field before the narrower rungs are accepted. The declared truthful question: does the real's margin above the band shrink as the surplus is removed, and does any rung separate the real from the band; if none does, say so and keep the family open with the disclosure. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

declared.budget_rule: the mapped set at rung B is the file's most frequent glyph characters up to B, ranked by the declared (descending count, character) rule, plus the word-boundary mark in the last position; a glyph character outside the rung's set renders to the dropped event and pairs across a dropped event do not count, exactly as the first screen's mapped-set rule drops characters beyond its count; IT's glyph pool is 23, so IT's real takes its full pool at every declared rung and the matrices stay rung-width with the unfilled slots riding zero pairs
declared.partition_rule: plants and band members re-encode the same truncated streams through the same declared partition rule at each rung's budget (floor shares of frequency, one slot at least per present letter, remaining slots by largest fractional remainder with ties to the ascending letter index, groups laid out letter by letter in descending letter frequency), each instrument replaying its declared seed kinds per (rung, instrument, index)
declared.floor_rule: floors unchanged in declaration: the five destroyed-adjacency shuffles per cell from the declared kinds at every rung, shuffling the rung's real kept ids, scored by the same held-out machinery, every floor required below the rung's real
declared.machinery_rule: unchanged from the held-out screen: the exact greedy reassignment climb on the climb half, exact pricing on the score half, the split by pair-index parity consuming no seed, restart 0 the rank initialisation from the climb half, restarts 1 onward the same seeded permutations of the 27 letter tokens, sweep cap 200 and 16 restarts at every rung and for every side
declared.models_and_anchors_rule: the language models, the truncated streams and therefore the anchors are rung-invariant: an anchor is the truncated plaintext stream's odd-half identity mean under the unchanged table, identical at every rung and recorded per rung
declared.seed_sharing: no new seed kinds are consumed; every (rung, instrument, index) replays its declared seed value afresh, so identical seeds draw identically at identical budgets and the narrower rungs draw from the same seed values declared here; the ladder consumes none of any other module's declared draws
declared.reproduction_check_rule: the rung at budget 36 must reproduce the frozen held-out artifact field for field (every cell field, every band member field and the declared models), checked immediately after the top rung is measured and before the narrower rungs run; a divergence aborts the ladder and no artifact is written
declared.side_instrument: the exact full-data climb is carried per rung beside every held-out value for attribution only; no verdict is built on it
declared.band_record_rule: membership, selection, ties and spreads are declared unchanged from the held-out screen; each member additionally records draws_climb_exact, its five climb-half totals at full precision, so the declared selection (best exact climb-half total, strict beyond 1e-12, ties to the first draw) is re-derivable from the stored artifact, because four-decimal rounded totals can coincide where exact totals differ
declared.verdict_rule: unchanged from the held-out screen, scored per rung: the rung's real held-out at or above the rung's smallest member band value is consistent-with-substitution; at or below the rung's largest floor's held-out value is not-consistent; strictly between is below-held-band
declared.margin_rule: every margin is computed from the stored rounded values: the real held-out mean minus the smallest member band value, rounded to four decimals
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so the ladder adds no exclusion of its own; a rung's verdicts are rung-level evidence on the narrower subclass encodings that rung's budget defines, and the family stays open unless the top rung itself reverses
declared.truthful_question: declared in advance: does the real's margin above the band shrink as the surplus is removed, and does any rung separate the real from the band; if none does, say so and keep the family open with the disclosure
